method: Public pinned source/static AST and text inspection plus current official Cloudflare documentation; no dependency installation, application import, runtime spike, deployment, cloud mutation or Desktop wake test.

runtime_pin.note: Workers Python/Pyodide version is compatibility-date selected; no exact installed runtime was queried or executed.

dependency_assessment.note: Pure/PyEmscripten/Pyodide packages are documented supported categories; host wheels in uv.lock do not establish current Pyodide incompatibility or exact-version availability. bcrypt declared but no direct bcrypt import found in scanned server src; do not call it proven startup blocker.

findings.observed: Package __init__ eagerly imports api, CLI and DatabaseInfra; api creates a module-level app; CLI eagerly imports uvicorn. Even importing a pure submodule reaches these package initializers. Standalone lifespan pings Redis, creates pgdbm pool, applies schemas/migrations. Library mode requires initialized db_infra plus redis and sets app.state resources/mutation handler.
findings.adaptation: Decouple package initializer/CLI; Workers ASGI entrypoint replaces uvicorn serve; initialize request-safe binding adapters at event time; explicitly qualify lifespan, cleanup and concurrency rather than assuming a daemon startup/shutdown. Disable packaged frontend and route assets through binding.

findings.observed: JSONL parser/depth-count validation, naming constants and cursor encoding/validation are mostly stdlib logic. Pagination response models need Pydantic. WorkspaceConfig parsing can be separated from local .beadhub reads.
findings.adaptation: Reuse extracted pure logic and tests after fixing package import graph; validate exact Pydantic/core version in Workers. Do not claim module imports have run.

findings.observed: DatabaseInfra builds server, beads and aweb schema managers on one shared PostgreSQL pool. Applies BeadHub migrations and packaged aweb migrations with aweb-aweb history. SQL includes schema/template tables, numbered parameters, JSONB/casts, PostgreSQL search indexes/functions, interval arithmetic, UUID arrays/LATERAL, row locking and transaction contracts. pgdbm is pure wheel but depends on asyncpg.
findings.adaptation: DO SQLite/D1 require deliberate schema/query/transaction/error/serialization changes and ownership routing, not a DSN swap. DO storage is private per object; cross-schema or cross-object work needs new transaction/commit rules. Retaining PostgreSQL via Hyperdrive is documented feasible for Python asyncpg with date >=2026-09-08 but is not Cloudflare-native storage. Exact asyncpg 0.31.0/pgdbm 0.4.0 pool behavior remains unverified.

findings.observed: Presence uses hashes, expiring keys, sets/indexes and pipelines. Rate limiting executes Lua atomic INCR+EXPIRE, TTL and fail-closed errors. BeadHub SSE subscribes Redis pubsub with keepalive/reconnect. aweb chat waiting uses sorted sets, TTL, pipelines and Lua stale-entry removal.
findings.adaptation: Native DO operations can express authoritative state, leases and atomic counters; define project/session keying, expiry timestamps, retry idempotency, cleanup and fanout explicitly. KV is not a drop-in Redis semantics replacement. External Redis TCP might be possible with modern sockets but exact redis 7.1.0 pubsub/pooling is unqualified and still retains Redis service. SSE transport can be adapted, but must define reconnection/replay from durable state rather than assuming pubsub history.

findings.observed: Inherited aweb owns identity/auth, messaging/chat, reservations, tasks, contacts, conversations and protocol routers; BeadHub mounts them and overrides selected agent/status/policy/task/claim paths. deps.get_db/get_redis use app.state, database contract get_manager; fire_mutation_hook awaits callback and catches errors despite fire-and-forget wording. aweb package initializer imports CLI. DID/signing import PyNaCl; custody uses cryptography AESGCM.
findings.adaptation: A reusable backend must reach aweb services as well as BeadHub routes. Keep backend-neutral service interfaces/errors/hooks upstream where feasible; BeadHub owns workspace/repo/beads/escalation/subscription integration. Extract truly pure aweb names/service_errors and portions of DID/stable-ID serialization only after separating crypto/storage imports; qualify signing/verification/encryption and preserve identity tenant binding with vectors. Native JS WebCrypto is an alternative implementation requiring contract tests.

findings.observed: Defaults and migrations read bundled files; frontend serves local dist if present; workspace_config reads current-directory .beadhub. Static scan found no subprocess or aiofiles use in BeadHub/aweb src despite aiofiles declared by BeadHub. CLI and local workspace/agent execution are distinct from coordination service.
findings.adaptation: Bundled read-only content may be packaged or embedded after verification; use bindings for durable writes/assets and settings. Do not move local repo/Beads Dolt/model execution into Workers. No server-side subprocess replacement is indicated by scanned source, but this does not qualify CLI/client operation in Workers. Threads and multiprocessing are not functional per Cloudflare stdlib docs; do not add thread-backed aiofiles work as port strategy.

findings.observed: Notification intent recording and processing are explicitly invoked by bead/bdh requests; no asyncio.create_task or FastAPI BackgroundTasks scheduling found in scanned server src. Outbox uses pending/failed attempts and per-entry FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; deliver_message uses inherited aweb service. SSE is live request work. Mutation hooks are awaited best-effort and exception swallowing may lose advisory broadcasts.
findings.adaptation: Keep intent/effect recovery durable and replayable. For guaranteed background draining use DO alarms or Queues with idempotent effects rather than process loops or unawaited coroutines. Alarms have at-least-once retries and one pending alarm per object; waitUntil is bounded (30 seconds after HTTP invocation end), not a durable scheduler. Server event/wakeup delivery is not proof Codex Desktop executed.

options.option: Python ASGI plus native DO adapters
options.benefit: Retain selected validation/models/routes/service logic; Python DO/SQLite/alarms are documented.
options.cost: Both BeadHub and aweb storage coupling must change; eager imports, crypto packages, lifespan and Redis semantics require qualification.

options.benefit: Direct native bindings, DO SQL/alarms/WebCrypto; breaking wire contracts allowed by map.
options.cost: Reimplement accepted domain invariants, tenant/auth binding, concurrency, subscriptions and effect recovery; existing tests become specification evidence rather than runtime proof.

options.benefit: Potentially highest source reuse; asyncpg Hyperdrive support is documented.
options.cost: Does not meet native-storage conversion alone; retains resource/cost/operations dependencies and needs exact-client qualification.

prototype_requirements: Freeze exact compatibility date, Python/Pyodide/tool versions and package resolution; bundle/import actual BeadHub+aweb, not a hello FastAPI app.
Qualify both package initializers and crypto identity round trips with public vectors; remove CLI eager imports.
Exercise actual create_app library lifecycle, env binding scoping and two concurrent tenant requests.
Demonstrate one real write/read/rollback claim or task path with selected DO/D1 backend and contention/retry/expiry invariants; migrate SQL deliberately.
Exercise outbox crash after effect/before receipt, duplicate delivery and alarm recovery plus SSE/client reconnect and durable replay.
Keep actual awake/running Codex Desktop wake+execution as separate required end-to-end qualification; this ticket proves none.
Measure CPU/memory/startup/storage/fanout and Cloudflare costs against USD40/month before rollout.
limitations: Source artifact aweb 0.3.8 pinned by released sdist sha256; attempted v0.3.8 and server-v0.3.8 upstream commit lookups returned 422, so no fabricated commit equivalence.
Cloudflare documentation is current as observed, not a recorded runtime execution.
No architecture decision or rollout authorization is made by these findings.
